source_title: Hyundai BAYON Colours: Mono-Tone, Dual-Tone and Matte Options - hyundai.com
source_excerpt:
Choosing a car colour is a personal decision. Some buyers prefer classic shades, while others want something that stands out on the road. The Hyundai BAYON offers a mix of both, with mono-tone colours, matte finishes and dual-tone options. If you are exploring the Hyundai BAYON colours , here is a look at the available shades, interior colour themes and variants that offer the dual-tone finish.
How Can You Explore the Hyundai BAYON Colours?
You can view the available Hyundai BAYON colours on the model page using the colour selector and 360-degree view. These features let you switch between shades and view the car from different angles. This helps you compare finishes before visiting a dealership or booking a test drive.
What Mono-Tone and Matte Colours Does the Hyundai BAYON Offer?
The Hyundai BAYON car colours come in six mono-tone shades and two matte finishes. Each gives the SUV a different look. The mono-tone colours are: â Atlas White: A classic white that suits a clean, simple look. â Fiery Red: A bright red for those who prefer a bolder shade. â Classy Blue: A deep blue with a distinctive finish. â Titanium Black: A classic black that highlights the SUV's shape. â Golden Bronze: A warm metallic shade. â Ecotronic Grey: A muted grey with a modern look. For buyers who prefer a matte finish, two options are available: â Titanium Black Matte: A black finish with a low sheen. â Classy Blue Matte: A blue finish with a subtle, understated appearance. The mono-tone and matte exterior colours come with a dual-tone black-and-olive-grey interior theme.
What Dual-Tone Colours Does the Hyundai BAYON Offer?
The Hyundai BAYON is available in two dual-tone combinations: Atlas White and Fiery Red, both paired with a titanium black roof. The contrasting roof gives the SUV a different look without changing the main body colour. These combinations are available with the Dual Tone Pack and come exclusively with the black interior featuring red accents.
The Dual Tone Pack adds black paint to three exterior elements: â Roof â Rear spoiler â Outside rear-view mirrors These details contrast with the body colour and give the SUV a sportier appearance.
The Dual Tone Pack is available as an option on the HX 5, HX 6, HX 8 and HX 10 variants. It is not available on the HX 2, HX 3 or HX 3+. If you prefer a dual-tone exterior, consider the HX 5 or a higher variant.
What Interior Colour Themes Does the Hyundai BAYON Offer?
The Hyundai BAYON comes with two interior colour themes. The available theme depends on the exterior colour combination. â Dual-Tone Black and Olive Grey: This interior theme is offered with the mono-tone and matte exterior colours. The mix of black and olive grey creates a balanced look that works well for everyday use. It is available across the range with these exterior finishes. â Black with Red Accents: The black interior with red accents has a sportier appearance. It is available only with the dual-tone exterior options, which pair Atlas White or Fiery Red with a titanium black roof. This means your exterior colour choice also affects the interior theme you can select.
How Does Colour Complement the Hyundai BAYON's Design?
The BAYON follows Hyundai's Art of Steel design philosophy, with a sculpted bonnet, defined body lines and distinctive H-Edge lighting. The different paint finishes bring out these design details in their own way. Atlas White highlights the body lines, while Titanium Black gives the SUV a darker appearance. Golden Bronze and Ecotronic Grey offer more muted alternatives, while Fiery Red makes a stronger visual statement. The matte finishes and black roof options provide further ways to personalise the car.
Which Hyundai BAYON Variants Offer the Different Colour Options?
The colour options available depend on the variant you choose. The HX 2, HX 3 and HX 3+ do not offer the Dual Tone Pack. The HX 5, HX 6, HX 8 and HX 10 offer it as an option. The black interior with red accents is available exclusively with the dual-tone exterior combinations, while the mono-tone and matte finishes come with the black and olive grey interior. If a particular colour combination is high on your list, check its availability when choosing your variant. This will help you narrow down your options before making a final decision.
Can You View the Hyundai BAYON in 360 Degrees?
Yes, the Hyundai BAYON model page features a 360-degree view and a colour selector. You can rotate the car and view it in different shades before visiting a dealership. This gives you a better idea of how each colour looks on the SUV, although the actual paint may appear slightly different depending on lighting and screen settings.
The Hyundai BAYON colour range includes options for different preferences, from classic mono-tone shades to matte finishes and sporty dual-tone combinations. Your choice also affects the interior theme and, if you want a contrasting black roof, the variant you need to select. The best way to choose a colour is to shortlist a few options and see them in person. Visit an authorised Hyundai dealership or book a test drive to see your preferred Hyundai BAYON colour before you decide.
Does the Hyundai BAYON come in dual-tone colours?
Yes, the Hyundai BAYON offers Atlas White and Fiery Red with a contrasting titanium black roof through the Dual Tone Pack.
Which BAYON variants offer the Dual Tone Pack?
The Dual Tone Pack is available as an option on the HX 5, HX 6, HX 8 and HX 10 variants. It is not available on the HX 2, HX 3 or HX 3+.
Is the black interior with red accents available with every exterior colour?
No, this interior theme is available only with the dual-tone exterior options. The mono-tone and matte colours come with the black and olive grey interior theme.
Can I view the Hyundai BAYON colours in 360 degrees?
Yes, the model page includes a 360-degree view and a colour selector, allowing you to view the SUV from different angles and compare the available shades.
